test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A person walks 6 km west, then 8 km south, and finally 6 km east. In which direction is he from his starting point?
solution:
Walks 6 km West → position: 6 km west of start

Walks 8 km South → position: 6 km west & 8 km south

Walks 6 km East → west and east cancel

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee6263f9c068fd36fc16d29ca5d742062d2544de211187bb612120b1f7cfedc1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/633458c2b2b379e21e8cdec69d140c5c48bc67ae41e5e216f5cde642155c06b0.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**
